    Corporate Profile


    申 洲 國 際 集 團 控 股 有 限 公 司（「申 洲 國 際」） Shenzhou Inter national Group Holdings Limited (“Shenzhou
    及 其 附 屬 公 司（統 稱「本 集 團」）為 全 球 最 大                   International”) and its subsidiaries (collectively the “Group”) is one of
    的 縱 向 一 體 化 針 織 製 造 商 之 一，主 要 以 代 工                the largest vertically integrated knitwear manufacturers in the world.
    (OEM)及 委 託 設 計(ODM)相 結 合 方 式 為 客 戶                 The Group is principally engaged in the manufacturing of high-end
    製造質量上乘的針織品。                                        knitwear for the customers by the method of combining OEM and
                                                       ODM.

    濟 技 術 開 發 區 和 越 南 西 寧 省，並 策 略 性 地 在                Technical Development Zone, the People’s Republic of China (“PRC”)
    中 國 寧 波 市 及 安 慶 市、越 南 胡 志 明 市 及 西 寧                and Tây Ninh Province, Vietnam, and the Group has strategically
    省 和 柬 埔 寨 金 邊 市 設 有 製 衣 工 廠，在 上 海、                 set up garment factories in Ningbo and Anqing of China, Ho Chi
    香 港 及 大 阪 均 設 有 銷 售 辦 事 處 或 代 表 處。現                Minh City and Tây Ninh Province of Vietnam and Phnom Penh of
    時 本 集 團 員 工 約94,340人，廠 房 佔 地 面 積 逾                 Cambodia. The Group also established sales offices or representative
    644萬 平 方 米，建 築 面 積 逾466萬 平 方 米，各                   offices in Shanghai, Hong Kong and Osaka. The Group currently
    類針織服裝產量約5億件。                                       has approximately 94,340 employees. The area of the factories is
                                                       over 6.44 million sq.m. and floor area covers over 4.66 million sq.m.,

    ADIDAS及PUMA等國際知名品牌客戶。產品                            NIKE, UNIQLO, ADIDAS and PUMA. The products’ markets are

    場。                                                 the US.

結 算 狀 況、未 償 還 結 餘 變 現 的 預 期 時 間 及 金
額 及 與 相 關 客 戶 的 持 續 貿 易 關 係）對 應 收 賬
款 的 可 收 回 性 進 行 定 期 評 估。管 理 層 亦 考 慮
可能影響客戶償還未償還結餘的能力的前瞻
性 資 料，以 估 計 用 於 減 值 評 估 的 預 期 信 貸 虧
損。根 據 管 理 層 的 減 值 評 估，並 無 計 提 信 貸
虧損撥備。
Management performed periodic
assessment on the recoverability of the trade
receivables and the sufficiency of provision
for impairment based on information
including the credit profile of different
customers, ageing of the trade receivables,
historical settlement records, subsequent
settlement status, expected timing and
a m o u n t s o f re a l i s a t i o n o f o u t s t a n d i n g
balances, and on-going trading relationships
with the relevant customers. Management
also considered forward-looking information
that may impact the customers’ ability to
repay the outstanding balances in order
to estimate the expected credit losses
for the impairment assessment. No credit
loss allowance was provided based on
management’s impairment assessment.

於按預期信貸虧損模式評估應收賬款及票據
減值時需要高水平管理層估計。
A high level of management estimation was
required when assessing the impairment
of trade and bills receivables under the
expected credit losses model.

   對該資產或負債最有利的市場進行。本                   liability, or in the absence of a principal market, in the most

   最佳經濟利益行事。                           pricing the asset or liability, assuming that market participants

   本集團就所持並非按公允值計量且其                    The Group recognises an allowance for expected credit losses

   期信貸虧損撥備。預期信貸虧損乃基於                   profit or loss. ECLs are based on the difference between the

   釐定。預期現金流量將包括出售所持抵                   rate. The expected cash flows will include cash flows from the
   押品或合約條款所包含的其他信貸升                    sale of collateral held or other credit enhancements that are
   級措施所得的現金流量。                         integral to the contractual terms.


  一般方法                                 General approach
   預期信貸虧損分兩個階段確認。就初步                   ECLs are recognised in two stages. For credit exposures for
   確認以來信貸風險並無大幅增加的信                    which there has not been a significant increase in credit risk
   貸敞口而言，會為未來12個月可能發生                  since initial recognition, ECLs are provided for credit losses
   違約的事件所產生的信貸虧損計提預                    that result from default events that are possible within the next
   期 信 貸 虧 損 撥 備（ 12個 月 預 期 信 貸 虧      12 months (a 12-month ECL). For those credit exposures for
   損）。就 初 步 確 認 以 來 信 貸 風 險 大 幅 增      which there has been a significant increase in credit risk since
   加的信貸敞口而言，須就預期於敝口的                   initial recognition, a loss allowance is required for credit losses
   餘下年期產生的信貸虧損計提減值撥                    expected over the remaining life of the exposure, irrespective of
   備，不 論 違 約 的 時 間（整 個 可 使 用 年 期       the timing of the default (a lifetime ECL).
   預期信貸虧損）
         。


   於每個報告日期，本集團評估一項金融                   At each reporting date, the Group assesses whether the
   工具的信貸風險自初步確認以來是否                    credit risk on a financial instrument has increased significantly
   大 幅 增 加。於 作 出 評 估 時，本 集 團 將 金       since initial recognition. When making the assessment,
   融工具於報告日期發生違約的風險與                    the Group compares the risk of a default occurring on the
   金融工具於初步確認日期發生違約的                    financial instrument as at the reporting date with the risk of a
   風 險 進 行 比 較，並 考 慮 毋 須 花 費 過 度       default occurring on the financial instrument as at the date of
   成本或精力即可獲得的合理及可靠資料                   initial recognition and considers reasonable and supportable
  （包 括 歷 史 及 前 瞻 性 資 料）。本 集 團 認        information that is available without undue cost or effort,
   為，若合約付款逾期超過30天即表示信                  including historical and forward-looking information. The Group
   貸風險有大幅增加。                           considers that there has been a significant increase in credit

      32. 儲備                                                32. RESERVES
           本集團於目前及過往年度之儲備金額                                       The amounts of the Group’s reserves and the movements

                                                                  the financial statements.


           (i)      法定盈餘公積金（「法定盈餘公積                               (i)     Statutory surplus reserve (“SSR”)
                    金」）
                    根據中國公司法及中國大陸附屬                                        In accordance with the Company Law of the PRC and the
                    公 司 之 組 織 章 程 細 則，各 中 國 大                             articles of association of the Mainland China subsidiaries,
                    陸附屬公司須將按照中國公認                                         each of the Mainland China subsidiaries is required to
                    會 計 原 則 釐 定 之 除 稅 後 利 潤10%                            allocate 10% of their profit after tax, as determined in
                    撥 入 至 法 定 盈 餘 公 積 金，直 至 有                             accordance with the PRC generally accepted accounting
                    關 公 積 金 達 到 註 冊 股 本 之50%為                             principles, to the SSR until the reserve reaches 50% of
                    止。部 分 法 定 盈 餘 公 積 金 可 用 於                             its registered capital. Part of the SSR may be converted
                    增 加 繳 足 股 本，惟 資 本 化 後 之 餘                             to increase paid-up capital, provided that the remaining
                    額不得少於註冊股本之25%。                                        balance after the capitalisation is not less than 25% of the
                                                                          registered capital.


           (ii)     匯兌波動儲備                                        (ii)    Exchange fluctuation reserve
                    匯兌波動儲備指因換算海外附屬                                        The exchange fluctuation reserve represents exchange
                    公司之財務報表產生之匯兌差                                         differences arising from the translation of the financial
                    額。                                                    statements of the foreign subsidiaries.


           (iii)    其他儲備                                          (iii)   Other reserve
                    其他儲備指不喪失控制權的情況                                        Other reserve represents the excess of the consideration
                    下，部 分 出 售 附 屬 公 司 所 獲 得 的                             received for partial disposal of a subsidiary without loss
